import sys
import math

def get_abs_value(x):
    return -x if x < 0 else x

def mod_exp(base, exp, mod):
    if exp <= 0:
        return 1
    half = mod_exp(base, exp // 2, mod)
    half = (half * half) % mod
    return half * base % mod if exp & 1 else half

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    N, M, mod = map(int, input[:3])
    factorials = [1] * (N + 1)
    inv_factorials = [1] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        factorials[i] = factorials[i - 1] * i % mod
        inv_factorials[i] = inv_factorials[i - 1] * mod_exp(i, mod - 2, mod) % mod

    count_vec = [0] * (M + 1)
    sum_vec = [0] * (M + 1)
    count_vec[0] = 1

    for m in range(1, M + 1):
        for k in range(m):
            left_c = count_vec[k] * inv_factorials[k] % mod
            right_c = count_vec[m - 1 - k] * inv_factorials[m - 1 - k] % mod
            left_s = sum_vec[k] * inv_factorials[k] % mod
            right_s = sum_vec[m - 1 - k] * inv_factorials[m - 1 - k] % mod
            count_vec[m] = (count_vec[m] + left_c * right_c % mod * (m + 1)) % mod
            sum_vec[m] = (sum_vec[m] + (left_s * right_s + left_c * right_s + left_s * right_c) % mod * (m + 1)) % mod
            sum_vec[m] = (sum_vec[m] + left_c * right_c % mod * (k * (k + 1) + (m - k) * (m - k - 1)) // 2) % mod
        count_vec[m] = count_vec[m] * factorials[m - 1] % mod
        sum_vec[m] = sum_vec[m] * factorials[m - 1] % mod

    count_res = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    sum_res = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    count_res[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(min(i, M) + 1):
            count_res[i][j] = count_res[i - 1][j]
            sum_res[i][j] = sum_res[i - 1][j]
            if j == i:
                count_res[i][j] = (count_res[i][j] + count_vec[i] * inv_factorials[i]) % mod
                sum_res[i][j] = (sum_res[i][j] + sum_vec[i] * inv_factorials[i]) % mod
            for k in range(1, min(j, i - 1) + 1):
                c = count_vec[k] * inv_factorials[k] % mod
                s = sum_vec[k] * inv_factorials[k] % mod
                count_res[i][j] = (count_res[i][j] + count_res[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c) % mod
                sum_res[i][j] = (sum_res[i][j] + (sum_res[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c + count_res[i - 1 - k][j - k] * s)) % mod

    final_ans = sum_res[N][M] * factorials[M] % mod
    print(final_ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
